$comment: Measured off the mesh rather than assumed (spec 140). The parts run along Z with the handle toward +Z: Blade -1.485..0.695, Guard 0.695..0.815, Collar 0.815..0.860, Grip 0.860..1.250, Pommel 1.250..1.485. So `at` is the middle of the grip cylinder and `point` is -Z. The blade is +/-0.127 wide in X and +/-0.030 thick in Y, which is what makes the flat's normal Y and the edges X -- that is read off the accessor bounds, not chosen.
name: Jian

provenance.note: 362 triangles, three materials, no skin and no animation -- a rigid body, which is the whole reason this is not a unitdef.
